features.remaining: BodyVr command service bound on the Z7 (component 0x042F, send 0x100F1F9E, 0xF040 read, 0xF1F1 10-byte position; 20 checks). Telemetry block, release/idle/file events, D2 restore and step calibration remain; then read-only probe, one-move test, four-frame series. Read-only VR telemetry probe (e5ac0844) ran on the camera on Nov 26: 48 reads, all OK, sensor not moved. Telemetry layout confirmed (target 0x00, error 0x06, state 0x22, measured 0x24; same as Z7II). One-move test (5fe15dcc) worked on the camera on Nov 26: the sensor moved to target (-16,0,0) (Z7II scale) and recentred, all acknowledged. Stabilisation stays held until a power cycle; Z7 D2 restore found (0x101C63F8, command 4, buffer 0xA235BA44) and built (2ff19bde). Series dry run (b68284dc) ran on the camera Nov 27: every position was followed (21/18 scale targets exact), but Nikon re-applies normal VR on each half-press and parks it when idle, so photographer-taken frames are not shifted; normal VR returned by itself afterwards. Module-fired release works on the camera (c813c457, Nov 27: 0x101ECFB0 accepted, Nikon reported 0x04100038, still record followed) but that build armed at power-on and stopped after one frame. Fixed build 3b2bb075: arms on a half-press, 0x04100038 completes, D2 re-sent, one click per frame (27 offline + 48 static checks); not staged. Remaining: module-fired release, capture guards, NX Studio tags, Z7 calibration.
